clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken researchers seek a Hardened Tumor for their work on the New Plague. Apothecary Berard first studied the growth before Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant.

Along Lake Lordamere, Vile Fin murlocs sometimes develop a rare, calcified growth. Apothecary Berard recorded the abnormality while studying wildlife along Silverpine Forest's eastern borders. The growth appears only in mature specimens along the shoreline and the Dawning Isles. Its cause remains uncertain, but the Royal Apothecary Society took notice of the dense tissue.
